column17: note

compile pass (security-owned, #766): main's nested-launch classification covers upstream's new subcommands: `agents` (opens the interactive command center) is Interactive like a bare launch; `queue` (queues input into a person's session through its app server), `migrate-rollouts` and `migrate-nfs-db` (rewrite the person's saved sessions or databases) and the internal `tcp-tunnel` (opens a CONNECT-proxy tunnel for a host) are Host; the removed `mcp-server` arm goes (D275). Other cli compile fixes (no behaviour change): doctor tests carry main's `corbanu_terminal_version`, `FileSystemPath::GlobPattern.scan`; logs_client uses upstream's `from_sqlite_home_with_nfs_enforcement(.., false)`; main's nested-launch and provider-account tests drive upstream's `exec_command` (`create_command_execution_sse_response`; `shell_command` was removed upstream).

The confirmation no longer waits for the ThreadSettingsApplied notification to pass the listener; Core replies before emitting it. Test-module imports for main's spawn-pane test; bespoke_event_handling's event-based finish (ThreadSettingsApplied/Error keyed by submission id) removed, since no confirmation is keyed by a Core submission id any more; unit test core_settings_reply_is_forwarded_to_its_confirmation
